title: Marriage and Divorce
notes: The chunk is dense, law-first, and assertive: porneia vs moicheia, Joseph’s betrothal, Deuteronomy’s nakedness vocabulary, Ezra’s commanded divorce, and Vashti’s formula all land with force and keep the author’s voice. Residual presenter staging is the main defect—several director cues still direct the reader instead of stating the claim. Two author-prose sentences open with And, violating house style. Scripture blocks and footnotes are clean; no doctrine or quote wording needs touch.

This chunk delivers a dense, law-positive remarriage-through-death case with tight Esther, Jeremiah, Hosea, John 8, and Revelation chaining. The Husband-pays-the-penalty thesis is clear and assertive. Residual presenter staging remains (Now open/watch, Listen to, mark that), and several author-prose sentences open with And, But, or That against house style. No doctrine, symbol IDs, or scripture-quote wording needs change; fixes are surgical cue removal and sentence-open repairs only.

proposals.old: And Proverbs names the bond by its Owner — the adulterous woman is one __“which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth *the covenant of her God*”__ (Proverbs 2:17).
proposals.new: Proverbs names the bond by its Owner — the adulterous woman is one __“which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth *the covenant of her God*”__ (Proverbs 2:17).
proposals.summary: Remove forbidden And-open in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style bars sentences in author prose from starting with And. Dropping the conjunction keeps the claim and density intact.

proposals.old: Now open the statute the Pharisees waved at Jesus:
proposals.new: The statute the Pharisees waved at Jesus reads:
proposals.summary: Replace director cue with a plain statement.
proposals.rationale: “Now open” is presenter staging. A declarative lead-in preserves the quote that follows and the author’s assertive register.

proposals.old: Read the rest of the statute’s shape.
proposals.new: The rest of the statute’s shape is pure restraint.
proposals.rationale: Director cues of the “Read that” family are barred. The replacement states the claim the next sentences then unpack.

proposals.old: Watch how the law describes marrying outside the covenant:
proposals.new: The law describes marrying outside the covenant this way:
proposals.rationale: “Watch how” is an explicit forbidden cue. A plain declarative keeps the scripture block and the law-positive voice.

proposals.old: Now read Ezra with that definition in hand.
proposals.rationale: “Now read” is presenter direction. The short assertion hands the reader the same move without the cue.

proposals.old: Mark that sentence, because it is the Bible’s standing formula for a deposed covenant partner.
proposals.new: The verdict is the Bible’s standing formula for a deposed covenant partner.
proposals.rationale: “Mark that” is listed as a forbidden director cue. Naming the verdict keeps the formula claim and the following parallels.

proposals.old: And Solomon — the very case Nehemiah cited — hears it over his strange wives: __“I will surely *rend the kingdom* from thee, and will *give it* to thy servant”__ (1 Kings 11:11).
proposals.new: Solomon — the very case Nehemiah cited — hears it over his strange wives: __“I will surely *rend the kingdom* from thee, and will *give it* to thy servant”__ (1 Kings 11:11).
proposals.summary: Remove forbidden And-open in author prose.
proposals.rationale: Author-prose sentences may not start with And. Dropping it leaves the parallel formula and the quote untouched.

proposals.old: Now open the greatest divorce case in Scripture — God’s own — and watch Him keep His own law at every step.
proposals.new: The greatest divorce case in Scripture is God’s own — and He keeps His own law at every step.
proposals.summary: Remove director cues Now open and watch.
proposals.rationale: House style bans presenter staging such as Now open and watch. The rewrite keeps the claim and density without the cue.

proposals.old: But now the Husband has a legal problem, and He states it Himself, citing His own statute:
proposals.new: The Husband now has a legal problem, and He states it Himself, citing His own statute:
proposals.summary: Remove author-prose sentence opening with But.
proposals.rationale: Author prose may not start with But. Moving now after the subject preserves meaning and flow.

proposals.old: Listen to Paul find the door:
proposals.rationale: Listen to is director staging. The shorter assert keeps the author’s voice and density.

proposals.old: That is why Hosea, God’s sign-and-similitude marriage, must not only endure his wife’s adultery but _buy her back_ — __“So I *bought her* to me for fifteen pieces of silver”__ (Hosea 3:2). The reunion is a fresh betrothal in the vocabulary this book keeps finding at the center: __“I will *betroth thee* unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in sym:sym-righteousness[righteousness], and in sym:sym-judgment[judgment]… and thou shalt sym:sym-knowing[know] the LORD”__ (Hosea 2:19-20).
proposals.new: This is why Hosea, God’s sign-and-similitude marriage, must not only endure his wife’s adultery but _buy her back_ — __“So I *bought her* to me for fifteen pieces of silver”__ (Hosea 3:2). The reunion is a fresh betrothal in the vocabulary this book keeps finding at the center: __“I will *betroth thee* unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in sym:sym-righteousness[righteousness], and in sym:sym-judgment[judgment]… and thou shalt sym:sym-knowing[know] the LORD”__ (Hosea 2:19-20).
proposals.rationale: Author prose may not start with That. This preserves the back-reference and all markup.

proposals.old: And mark that the trap was lawless on its face: the statute they quoted requires *both* — __“they shall *both* of them die, both the *man* that lay with the woman, and the woman”__ (Deuteronomy 22:22; Leviticus 20:10) — and a woman taken in the very act was taken with a man they knew and did not bring.
proposals.new: The trap was lawless on its face: the statute they quoted requires *both* — __“they shall *both* of them die, both the *man* that lay with the woman, and the woman”__ (Deuteronomy 22:22; Leviticus 20:10) — and a woman taken in the very act was taken with a man they knew and did not bring.
proposals.summary: Remove And mark that director cue and sentence-open.
proposals.rationale: Mark that is an explicit banned director cue, and And is a banned sentence open. Dropping both leaves the legal claim intact.

proposals.old: And in the very next breath:
proposals.summary: Remove author-prose sentence opening with And.
proposals.rationale: Author prose may not start with And. The shortened form keeps the transition.

proposals.old: And the marriage Scripture will not let go of is the covenant one — defended in the law, mourned by the prophets, kept by God Himself through His wife’s adultery, His own bill of divorce, His death, and the wedding feast He has already announced.
proposals.new: The marriage Scripture will not let go of is the covenant one — defended in the law, mourned by the prophets, kept by God Himself through His wife’s adultery, His own bill of divorce, His death, and the wedding feast He has already announced.
proposals.summary: Remove author-prose sentence opening with And.
proposals.rationale: Author prose may not start with And. Dropping the opener preserves the full claim and cadence.
